v1.0.1 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.1 Official
content: Improved stability and fixed bugs: HyperLis failed to start on some machines with AMD CPU or VGA.
Fixed an issue where some applications could not be downloaded in the Downloads section.
Fixed ScaleDPI error: Enables HyperLis to always display full content regardless of screen resolution and layout scale percentage.
Fixed an issue preventing the download of the Windows Optimized ISO file from Zịt's Tech Lab page in the USB Boot section.
Added the 'Disable Copilot AI' feature to the System section for Windows 10.
Added AI Agent applications to Downloads: Codex GPT, Codex CLI.
Added Browser applications to Downloads: Opera, Opera GX.
Added Development applications to Downloads: DBeaver.
Added Communication applications to Downloads: Zalo, Facebook, Instagram, Threads, LinkedIn.
Added Utility applications to Downloads: Notion, Process Hacker, Stardesk.
Added Gaming applications to Downloads: Razer Cortex, Razer Synapse 2, Razer Synapse 3, Razer Synapse 4.
Added Ping & Latency Tool applications to Downloads: GearUp Booster, LagoFast.

v1.0.2 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.2 Official
content: Fixed an issue where HyperLis was triggering multiple PowerShell and batch files abnormally.
Fixed incorrect RAM identification on the Dashboard from DDR5 to DDR4.
Fixed Widget Taskbar issue.
Fixed loading freeze when installing or uninstalling applications.
Fixed an issue where 'Clear Selection' in Downloads only cleared visible apps instead of all selected apps.
Improved activity logging: No longer logs on every startup; instead, it now records user actions and currently running or activated processes (including .ps1 and .bat scripts).
Added the ability to remove AI features from browsers.
Added Driver Import feature for drivers previously exported using the Driver Export feature.

Added Utility applications to Downloads: Microsoft PC Manager, AIDA 64 (including Extreme, Engineer, Business, and Network Audit editions), OCCT, Vencord (including Discord, Discord Canary, and Discord PTB editions).
Added Development applications to Downloads: CodeBlock, WinUI 3, WinUI 2, WPF Gallery, ViveTool, Ubuntu Pro for WSL, and more.
Added Multimedia Tools applications to Downloads: Netflix.
Improved the cleaning algorithm in the Cleaning section.

v1.0.3 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.3 Official
content: Fixed display issues on Hardware Info and Download tabs (larger checkboxes).
Fixed USB Boot not being detected after installing Bootloader.
Fixed Download tab unable to install winget apps after reinstalling Windows: Added winget detection and installation feature.
Fixed incorrect RAM identification on the Dashboard from DDR5 to DDR4.
Added Windows installation functionality for Legacy BIOS firmware
Added Printer Error Fix feature.
Added Tooltip Popup feature: Displays information when users hover over items (General and Windows tabs).
Added Hard Drive and Battery health check feature for laptops.
Added Find Driver feature matching your specific laptop/PC model.
Added Printer Driver removal feature, quick access to Devices & Printers and Print Management.
Added ISO-only download, bootloader-only creation, and the ability to copy additional ISO files to an existing USB Boot.
Added Windows Error Fix feature.
Added Disable Windows Update feature.
Removed Backup and Restore buttons from the Startup tab.

v1.0.4 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.4 Official
content: Removed MAS Activation feature (As per document No. 314/BQTG-QL&HTQT).
Removed Office download feature in the Extend Features section, replaced with Office Setup.
Removed Game Configs and Fix game errors tabs.
Added Windows Edition Conversion feature via SKUs: Easily convert to any Windows edition without reinstalling Windows.
Revamped the Office download and installation interface: Separated into a distinct tab with support for various Office versions.
Added applications to Downloads: Clipchamp, OpenShot, WPS, Polaris, Only Office.
Fixed an issue where the Enhance Privacy feature failed to open on some machines.
Fixed calendar opening bug when activating Optimize for Extreme Gaming: Using this feature will now automatically enable 'Disable Notification Center' on the Taskbar.
Improved the logging algorithm.
Improved Dashboard interface: Smoother UI/UX, completely eliminated lag issues.

v1.0.5 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.5 Official
content: Added Auto-Update and Check for Updates feature: From v1.0.5, users can manually check for updates, or HyperLis will automatically check and show a pop-up notification when a new version is available.
Added Windows License Backup and Restore feature in the License section.
Changed UI and working algorithm of app uninstallation feature: UWP Apps now includes a script to remove Bloatwares based on available Presets.
Added Winget CLI to the Application Download algorithm: As a fallback in case the native Winget is outdated or unavailable.
Added feature to identify the installed OEM Key on the machine.
Added feature to Import High and Ultimate Powerplan in the Windows section.
Fixed some minor UI bugs related to Office Setup.

v1.0.6 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.6 Official
content: Improved S.M.A.R.T algorithm when reading hard drive information, ensuring more accurate data reading and output.
Fixed UI bugs for Import and Export Presets Pop-ups in UWP Apps.
Modified Startup algorithm: Scans shell:startup and Task Scheduler.
Added feature to remove Windows and Office cracks.
Improved the algorithm for reading OEM Keys and license statuses in License Management and SKU Edition Conversion.
Changed license status notifications: Can now distinguish between unauthorized licenses activated via MAS and genuine licenses.
Improved the Printer Error Fix algorithm, resolving errors like 0x00000709, Cannot Connect,... more thoroughly.
Removed the option to convert editions to IoT Enterprise LTSC due to system limitations.
Modified the algorithm to allow edition conversion from Home to LTSC on Windows 11.
Fixed an algorithm bug where converting from Enterprise LTSC to Home failed to recognize the OEM key, error code: 0xC004F012.

v1.0.7 Official.title: HYPERLIS - Changelog v1.0.7 Official
content: Refined UI for Dashboard, License Management, and UWP Apps.
Updated new optimization algorithm for Gaming.
Updated and added new features to WSAP.
Re-optimized all algorithms in WSAP, resolved remaining issues, and provided full support for Unattend and Drivers.
Updated WSAP algorithm: Automatically detects BitLocker and Secure Boot.
Improved the algorithm for UWP Apps.
Fixed an issue where the Gaming optimization algorithm caused a black background in File Explorer on Windows 25H2 and 26H2, causing system lag.
